impact.text: A missing reentrancy guard in `_withdraw()` will cause balance accounting corruption for the staking contract and all future stakers

precondition_sources.text: The attacker owns two staked services (serviceA and serviceB) in the staking contract.
The attacker is an unprivileged plain contract requiring no special roles.

intent_sources.text: The contract balance state variable MUST equal the actual ETH held by the contract (balance == address(this).balance).
A single unstake per transaction should decrement balance by the corresponding reward amount, with no reentrant second unstake.
